jobs.description:
Practicum Education & Specialized Training Coordinator, Social Welfare (5256C) #89427 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
Located within the world's finest public university and one of the most diverse regions in the nation, the UC Berkeley School of Social Welfare strives to transform the systems that perpetuate poverty and social disadvantage. UC Berkeley Social Welfare develops effective leaders and scholars committed to solving complex social problems; produces, disseminates, and utilizes research to improve social-service delivery and policy through critical thinking and evidence-based knowledge; and prepares the next generation of culturally-competent social workers, researchers, and teachers dedicated to serving the most vulnerable members of our society.
  
  
The Practicum Education Program serves over 200 MSW students and has regular interface with over 150 agencies at any given time. MSW students engage in practicums across a range of public settings, including, but not limited to, public schools, hospitals, nonprofit agencies, and mental health clinics. These practicums require student, faculty, and staff awareness of and adherence to university policies and regulations, agency policies and regulations, and social work professional regulations.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Practicum Education & Specialized Training Coordinator works under the direction of the Senior Director of Admissions, Advising, and Student Experience and collaboratively with the Dean's Office to manage program resources and conduct analytical studies of moderate scope and complexity to address policy and procedural issues. This position maintains secure systems for collecting student health clearances, student placement data, and other programmatic data, while coordinating administration of the Pupil Personnel Services Credential (PPSC) in Social Work and workforce programs.
  
  
The Practicum Education & Specialized Training Coordinator supports practicum education by managing business partnerships with internship sites, coordinating the online interface for student internship search and matching, and managing learning contracts and student evaluations. This role handles sensitive onboarding data, including Protected Health Information (PHI) and background checks. Additionally, the position manages university-sponsored training and events and ensures data management and quality assurance in accordance with program policy.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
The First Review Date for this job is October 29, 2026. For full consideration, please apply by the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Data and Systems Maintenance
  
  
Applies professional concepts to perform maintenance and analysis of data and systems pertaining to moderately complex projects, policies, and/or processes and functions.
  
Supports practicum education operations by maintaining accurate, confidential, secure, and timely data within multiple data management systems. With guidance from the Associate Dean for Curriculum and the Senior Director of Admissions, Advising, and Student Experience, ensures consistency and quality assurance in accordance with the national accrediting body, the Council on Social Work Education, when engaging with and maintaining policies, projects, and issues that support program operations.
  
Provides regular technical support and training for database issues encountered by students, agency partners, and/or school representatives. Resolves procedural and technical issues in the context of department policies and procedures with a customer-service mindset.
  
Ensures proper database permissions and access for practicum instructors, faculty, students, advisors, and administrators, and that security roles and data storage align with UC data protection requirements.
  
Proactively identifies, proposes, and executes approved business process improvement projects, taking into account business practice and technical considerations.
  
Helps establish standards, guidelines, and best practices for database deliverables and program processes.
  
Ensures that operations and digital content comply with local and federal policies.
  
  
Analytical Reporting
  
  
Gathers and assembles analytical and factual data on assigned problems and issues to prepare reports and/or analyses summarizing information on the assigned issues and commenting on other significance for internal department constituents.
  
Prepares student placement, agency contact, student competency, and other reports as requested. In collaboration with the team, identifies trends, forecasts needs, and supports further analysis.
  
Performs analytical studies on a variety of policies, research initiatives, programs, and issues.

jobs.title: Manager, Clinical Operations
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Guardant Health is a leading precision oncology company focused on guarding wellness and giving every person more time free from cancer. Founded in 2012, Guardant® is transforming patient care and accelerating new cancer therapies by providing critical insights into what drives disease through its advanced blood and tissue tests, real-world data and AI analytics. Guardant tests help improve outcomes across all stages of care, including screening to find cancer early, monitoring for recurrence in early-stage cancer, and treatment selection for patients with advanced cancer. For more information, visit guardanthealth.com and follow the company on LinkedIn , X (Twitter) and Facebook .

**About the Role:**

The Manager of Clinical Operations is responsible for the technical operations of the Clinical Laboratory. The Manager monitors patient and quality control testing results, writes and reviews standard operating procedures, addresses technical issues and takes remedial action when needed. The Manager ensures laboratory staff are correctly trained on all processes and supervises both licensed and unlicensed laboratory team members. As a leader of the Clinical Operations function as well, the Manager will be responsible for supervision of the laboratory staff. The Manager demonstrates good judgment, sound analysis and decision making, the ability to remain professional and composed under pressure and the ability to communicate effectively across levels and functions. The Manager will ensure that the Clinical Lab team adheres to CLIA and CAP standards. The Manager complies with all applicable local, state and federal laboratory requirements and operates under the direction of the Laboratory Director and Director of Clinical Operations.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Accurately monitor molecular testing
* Conduct and oversee daily quantitation and qualification assessment of molecular data generated during testing
* Lead a variety of other essential laboratory activities, including reagent qualification, inventory management, procedure writing, inspection preparation, assay validation and investigation
* Work with the Clinical Laboratory General Supervisor, Technical Supervisor and the Accessioning Supervisor on the laboratory’s quality control and quality assurance procedures, technical troubleshooting and improvement procedures, reagent manufacturing, and training and education programs
* Review and document routine preventive maintenance and independently identify and troubleshoot highly complex problems that adversely affect test performance
* Identify root cause and document all corrective actions taken with test systems
* Oversee training and competency of new and existing laboratory personnel
* Manage stability study, validation protocols, and other process improvement and new assay projects
* Participate in audits and inspections
* Perform biennial review of Standard Operating Procedures
* Participate in introduction of assay improvements, new assay configurations and validation
* Support the Clinical Operations team and be responsible for the daily operations of the laboratory including but not limited to scheduling, independently troubleshooting and resolving technical and non-technical high complexity problems
Report all concerns of test quality and/or safety to the Laboratory Director or Safety Officer.  

  

**Essential Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Biomedical Laboratory Science, Clinical Science or related field
* At least eight years of Clinical Laboratory experience or equivalent high complexity and volume laboratory experience preferred
* At least two years of supervisory experience preferred
* Working knowledge of local, state, and federal laboratory regulations
* Working knowledge of FDA QSR and ISO 13485 requirements a plus
* Laboratory experience within the last year preferred
* Experience in molecular biology techniques preferred
* Strong working knowledge of local, state, and federal laboratory regulations
* Able to integrate and apply feedback in a professional manner
* Ability to manage daily test processing needs with high emphasis on quality
* Ability to analyze and problem solve basic issues that impact test performance
* Ability to work as part of a team
* Strong computer and automation skills
* Ability to proactively communicate consistently, clearly, and honestly
* Outstanding professionalism, leadership, and communications skills
* Strong communicator with ability to maintain open communication with internal employees, managers and customers as needed
* Ability to provide direct supervision to laboratory personnel
Strong project management abilities.  

  

**Work Environments:**

* Hours and days may vary depending on operational needs;
* Standing or sitting for long periods of time may be necessary;
* May be exposed to hazardous materials, blood specimens and instruments with moving parts, heating or freezing elements, and high-speed centrifugation;
* May be required to lift routine office supplies and use office equipment;
* Majority of the work is performed in a desk/office environment; and
Ability to sit for extended periods of time.  

  

**AI & Digital Fluency**

Demonstrate curiosity, sound judgment, and the ability to critically evaluate and responsibly leverage AI-enabled tools in accordance with company policies, ethical standards, and regulatory requirements to improve the efficiency, effectiveness, and quality of work.

jobs.description:
Description:

Now is the time to join PDS Health. You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!

Overview:

The role of the Operations Manager Trainee (OMT) is to gain an understanding of the skills and company knowledge to independently run a financially viable PDS supported dental office. The OMT is responsible for engaging in and owning their professional development through completing the OM Development Program while being supported by their direct supervisor. This will be done in a variety of ways: through structured curriculum completion, on the job practical application and development meetings. The OMT role is hired with the expectations that each individual will be able to independently manage a dental office in 4-6 months, following timely completion of the OM Development Program.

**Responsibilities**

* Modeling company culture, values, standards and best operational practices based on the We Believe Behavioral Framework; actively learning how to create an environment that promotes PDS culture and values daily
* Assessment, hiring and retention of right fit team members through comprehensive training, supervision, counseling and coaching
* Assess, investigate, and resolve staff and patient issues by analyzing the facts and circumstances to develop timely, effective, logical yet creative solutions
* Execution of the PDS Operational Model with consistency to meet identified office imperatives in partnership with the Owner Dentist
* Driving year over year revenue and profit growth
* Management of expenses to achieve monthly goals and budget
* Show proficiency and adherence to cash management and accounting protocols
* How to be the catalyst in team development of the Perfect Patient Experience
* How to deliver effective leadership, coaching and mentoring with team members in an effort to identify and implement opportunities for improvement
* Importance of keeping commitments and open communications with direct supervisors that develops trust-based relationships and bringing forth issues and concerns openly and early
* Maintains an appropriate professional appearance and demeanor in accordance with company policies; addresses others professionally and respectfully
* Gains proficiency and understands the tools and resources available with regards to People related functions, such as assessment, hiring, retention, performance evaluation, separation processes and compensation guidance and execution
* Ensure Compliance with Company policies, as well as State, Federal and other regulatory bodies
* Report weekly to Regional Manager detailing accomplishments, areas for improvement, clear performance goals, and effectiveness of systems
* By end of development program, show competency in managing a team of both Front Office and Back Office team members, displaying leadership and team development capabilities
* Develop and implement an office success plan; including development of staff, and office protocols to provide for efficient operations during manager absences
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned by direct supervisor that will result in improved team member development outcomes

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Five or more years of related work experience in operational management
* Operations Manager Trainee must possess and maintain a valid driver’s license and automobile insurance. Driver’s license must be verified by completing a motor vehicle record check at the time of hire
* Operations Manager Trainees are required to timely travel to multiple offices per day, in some cases several times per day, and must have reliable means of transportation to travel to assigned offices
* In lieu of a valid driver’s license and automobile insurance, Operations Manager Trainee must have reliable means of alternate transportation which would allow for required, timely travel to multiple offices per day, in some cases several times per day
* Travel may be planned or unplanned and is subject to change without notice

**Preferred**

* Associate degree, Bachelor’s degree
* Five or more years of experience leading a team, mentoring and coaching subordinates

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities**

* Results Oriented (Energetic self-starter; sets realistic goals; meets commitments; persistent, prioritizes daily to achieve results)
* Effective Team Builder (Character/Integrity; communicates openly; willingness to confront; motivator/inspirer; educator/trainer, promotes learning; effective assessor of talent; consistent)
* Patient Advocate (flexible and adaptive; empathetic; passionate; ethical
* Process Focused Operator (data driven decision-maker; detailed; organized and structured; comprehensive knowledge of all operational processes; computer proficient)
* Financial Acumen (understands profit drivers; utilizes metrics to manage; builds the financial understanding of staff and clinicians; understands local market drivers and competition
* Influencer (active listener/observer of behavior; builds trust with those requiring coaching; creates a win/win need for change; tailors coaching style to the individual’s needs; recognizes and celebrates improvement to sustain change)
* Requires knowledge of Dental Plans,insurances fees, administrative guidelines, limitations and exclusions, reporting systems; business correspondence and business reporting techniques; and business principles of profit & loss statements
* Skills required include use of knowledge of all Microsoft Applications, Epic, 1VU, BOX, and use of standard office equipment

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Description:

**Primary Objective**

The Business Operations Manager leads the internal operations of a distribution business that supplies equipment and materials to contractors and public agencies in California for Traffic Signals, Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), and underground utility projects. The role has authority over billing, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and office administration, and manages the supervisors and staff who perform that work. The Operations Manager serves as the primary liaison between the business unit and the corporate finance department, and is the local resource that employees, managers, and leadership turn to for operational questions and decisions.

This is not an accounting position. General ledger accounting, month-end close, and financial reporting are performed by the corporate finance department. The Operations Manager applies a strong working knowledge of accounting principles, including debits and credits, journal entries, inventory, fixed assets, and supporting documentation, to make sound operational decisions, ensure local transactions are accurate and complete, and support corporate finance.

JAM Services offers a Full Benefits plan including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and LTD insurance. We also provide a 401(K) plan with a 6% Safe Harbor match, PTO and 10 Holidays.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

The Business Operations Manager spends the majority of their time managing the business unit’s internal operations and the employees who carry them out. The role exercises discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the business unit, including staffing, credit and collection decisions, process design, and operating policies, within the overall direction of business unit leadership and corporate finance.

**Leadership and Team Management**

* Manages the AR / Collections, Billing, and office administration functions, directly supervising the AR / Collections Supervisor, the Billing Supervisor, and administrative staff.
* Hires, trains, and develops staff; sets performance expectations; conducts performance reviews; and makes decisions or recommendations on pay, promotion, discipline, and termination.
* Sets department priorities, staffing levels, and work schedules to meet business needs and deadlines.
* Builds a team culture of accuracy, accountability, and service to internal and external customers.

**Billing, Accounts Receivable, and Accounts Payable**

* Oversees billing, accounts receivable, collections, and accounts payable to ensure transactions are timely, accurate, and properly documented.
* Establishes and approves authority limits for credit, payment arrangements, adjustments, and write-offs, and makes final decisions on matters escalated by the supervisors, within corporate policy.
* Oversees the company’s lien and payment protection process to safeguard collections on private and public works projects.
* Reviews and approves vendor invoices, expense coding, and payment requests in accordance with corporate approval policies.
* Monitors cash flow drivers, including DSO, past-due balances, shipped-not-billed, and vendor payment timing, and takes action to address issues.

**Corporate Finance Liaison and Financial Support**

* Serves as the primary point of contact between the business unit and the corporate finance department.
* Provides corporate finance with accurate, complete documentation for journal entries, accruals, inventory, fixed assets, and month-end close.
* Researches and resolves account discrepancies, reconciling items, and audit requests in partnership with corporate finance.
* Translates financial information and corporate policies into practical guidance for local managers and staff.
* Supports budgeting and forecasting by providing operational data and insight to business unit leadership and corporate finance.

**Inventory, Assets, and Documentation**

* Oversees inventory transaction accuracy, cycle counts, and physical inventory processes in coordination with warehouse leadership.
* Maintains records and documentation for company assets, including equipment and vehicles, and supports fixed asset tracking.
* Ensures business records, contracts, and supporting documents are organized, retained, and accessible in accordance with company policy.

**ERP Systems and Technology**

* Serves as the business unit’s lead ERP user and decision-maker for local system setup, workflows, and reporting.
* Leads or supports ERP implementation activities, including process design, data migration, testing, training, and go-live support.
* Identifies opportunities to use system tools, automation, and AI to improve accuracy, efficiency, and reporting.
* Ensures staff are trained and use systems consistently and correctly.

**Office Administration**

* Oversees office administration, including facilities, office supplies, vendor services, and administrative processes.
* Partners with Human Resources on local administrative needs such as onboarding logistics, timekeeping oversight, and policy communication.
* Serves as the go-to resource for employees throughout the business unit on operational questions, policies, and procedures.

**Decision Support and Process Improvement**

* Provides business unit leadership with analysis and recommendations to support operational and financial decisions.
* Designs, documents, and implements standard procedures and internal controls across billing, AR, AP, and office operations.
* Develops and monitors key performance metrics and reports results to leadership.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**Performance Measures**

* Days sales outstanding (DSO) and past-due balances.
* Shipped-not-billed balance and billing accuracy.
* Accuracy, timeliness, and completeness of documentation provided to corporate finance.
* Accounts payable processed accurately and on time.
* Inventory accuracy and audit results.
* Team performance, retention, and development.

jobs.title: Global Planning and Operations Escalation Manager
jobs.description:
**The group you’ll be a part of**
---------------------------------

The Global Operations Group brings information systems, facilities, supply chain, logistics, and high-volume manufacturing together to drive the engine of our global business operations. We help Lam deliver industry-leading solutions with speed and efficiency, while actively supporting the resilient and profitable growth of Lam's business.

**The impact you’ll make**
--------------------------

The Global Spares Planning Escalation Manager is responsible for leading end-to‑end management of high‑severity incidents, chronic issues, and escalated customer or stakeholder concerns across the Global Spares organization. This role ensures cross functional team formation, rapid containment, thorough root‑cause analysis, cross‑functional alignment, and implementation of long‑term corrective actions that improve operational stability and customer experience.

The position partners closely with Global Planning & Operations teams, Regional Spares, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Customer Operations, Product Groups and senior leadership to minimize business impact and prevent recurrence of systemic issues.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

**Escalation Ownership & Incident Response**

* Serve as single point accountability for critical business/customer critical escalations, ensuring timely, transparent communication and resolution.
* Lead cross‑functional response teams to drive coordinated actions for high‑severity operational issues.
* Assess escalation across technical, operational and commercial dimensions to balance priority across the team.
* Accurately document incidents, containment, root cause, and decisions.
* Executive communication and alignment.
* Cross-functional leadership without direct authority.
* Decision facilitation & tradeoff management.
* Monitor incident progress, remove barriers, and escalate risks as needed to ensure swift containment and recovery.

**Problem Management**

* Rapid Problem Framing (Signal>Noise): taking fragmented inputs and quickly framing the problem, blocking issue/decision, and business impact.
* Taking a systems approach throughout the semiconductor value chain allows issues and solutions to be assessed in terms of suppliers, factories, production, installation, customer process qualification, and customer FAB operations.

**Position Summary**  
The Buck Institute’s Clinical Research Core is looking for an organized, motivated clinical research leader to run the in-person visits for THRIVE and serve as the operational heart of our on-site clinic.  
  
THRIVE is the clinical validation arm of PROSPR, an ARPA-H-funded program working to design the first FDA registration trial for a gerotherapeutic. THRIVE is developing the aging-relevant outcome measures such a trial would rely on, seeing how they perform with real participants, and testing them in a YMCA-guided lifestyle intervention.  
  
**Why join us**

* **Real ownership.** Clinical research is growing fast at the Buck, and our team is small. You’ll have high visibility and a direct hand in every stage of planning, conducting, and reporting research.
* **Variety.** Your time splits roughly evenly between leading THRIVE study visits and managing a clinic that runs 6–10 diverse studies on-site.
* **Great colleagues.** You’ll work alongside our Clinical Research Co-Directors (Dr. Newman, MD, PhD, a practicing geriatrician, and Dr. Brianna Stubbs, PhD, a clinical research scientist with more than a decade of experience) and an experienced Clinical Operations Manager.
* **A mission that matters.** Your work helps lay the groundwork for testing interventions that could extend healthy years of life.

**Key Responsibilities**  
*THRIVE Study Leadership (~50%)*

* Lead day-to-day execution of THRIVE in line with the protocol, GCP, ICH guidelines, and Buck Clinical Research SOPs.
* Translate the protocol into participant flow and scheduling across the clinic and community sites, adapting quickly when one change affects staff, rooms, and equipment at once.
* Lead a team of two senior and two junior research associates who collect data at community locations 2-3 days per week.
* Partner with the Recruitment Specialist to keep enrollment on pace; track milestones and flag risks to study leadership.
* Own IRB compliance (continuing reviews, amendments, documentation), data quality and query resolution, biospecimen tracking, and protection of participant PHI and sponsor confidential information.
* Run THRIVE team meetings, implement protocol amendments, and manage relationships with consortium partners, collaborators, and vendors while keeping stakeholders informed.

*Clinic Management (~50%)*

* Be the clinic’s quarterback: stay on top of visits, staff coverage, and emerging issues across all studies, and resolve bottlenecks, coverage gaps, role confusion, and conflicts before they affect participants or data.
* Oversee procedure quality by observing procedures and reviewing source documentation.
* Oversee safety reporting and escalation for adverse events, serious adverse events, adverse events of special interest, and protocol deviations, including corrective and preventive actions.
* Lead, mentor, and train Clinical Research Associates; balance workloads, provide feedback, and maintain the SOP library and training records.

* Manage clinical equipment, supplies, biospecimen inventory and LIMS, clinical space, and vendors for lab analysis and other services.
* Support new-study intake with operational reviews and budget inputs, and coordinate participant payments with finance.
* Pitch in on study visits, sample processing, and data entry as needed; help improve clinic practice; and promote cultural respect and multilingual recruitment.

One of the following in clinical research or project management in a biomedical or clinical research setting:

* High school diploma/technical degree and 8+ years of experience
* Bachelor's degree and 4+ years of experience i
* Master's or PhD degree and 2+ years of experience

* Clinical skills/background sufficient to train, mentor, and oversee quality for study staff performing clinical procedures
* Supervisory or team leadership experience
* Experience preparing or submitting IRB protocols, amendments, or continuing reviews
* Strong organization across concurrent studies and priorities, with reliable follow-through, initiative, and proactive problem-solving
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication; comfortable working independently, as part of a team, and with all levels of management
* Attention to deadlines and budgetary guidelines

**Nice to have**

* Professional certification such as PMP, ACRP-CP, SOCRA CCRP, or equivalent
* Experience with project management software (e.g., Wrike, MS Project) and EDC systems (e.g., REDCap)
* Phlebotomy certification/experience
* Clinical research experience in a non-profit/academic setting

**Compensation & Job Details**

* Full-time, 40 hours per week, onsite. You’ll be available in person or on call during clinic visit hours (7:30 am – 2:00 pm)
* Salary: $90,000 - $100,000 / year commensurate with experience
* Benefits include health insurance, paid parental leave, PTO, and a 401(k) with 5% employer match

**About the Buck**  
At the Buck, we aim to end the threat of age-related diseases for this and future generations. We’re an independent, non-profit institute in Marin County, CA, bringing together passionate scientists from many disciplines to understand and slow the ways we age. jobs.title: Program Lead, AV Remote Assistance Partner Enablement
jobs.description:
About the Role
  
  
Leading at Uber means setting direction in motion, not waiting for perfect conditions. As a Program Leader, you will act as a strategic and organizational partner to senior leadership, driving the high-leverage initiatives that keep our global support engine running. You will build high-performing teams in ambiguous environments, making hard calls under pressure and carrying the weight of decisions that define how we support millions of users across the globe.
  
  
As Program Lead, AV Remote Assistance Partner Enablement, you'll own the launch and ongoing evolution of Remote Assistance (RA) across our global portfolio of AV partners-each with their own tooling, workflows, and operational requirements. You'll drive decisions on how the program is built, staffed and run: the infrastructure, the vendor ecosystem, the operating model and the product roadmap that ties them together. This is a high-autonomy, high-ambiguity role for an operator who can launch fast and design for what the program needs to look like with both immediate- and long-term impact.
  
  
What You'll Do

* Stand Up and Lead Global Operations: Launch RA Operations for new AV partners on their own tooling and in their own markets, owning labor, infrastructure and tech readiness and building scalable playbooks.
* Own the Vendor Ecosystem: Run selection, onboarding and lifecycle management for RA staffing and operations partners, set the performance bar and enforce it through SLAs, business reviews, and corrective action and own compliance against contractual and regulatory requirements market by market.
* Drive the Product: Serve as the operations counterpart to the teams developing tooling, driving continuous improvement of the integration layer that connects our systems into AV partner platforms and converting field signals-including workflow friction, failure modes, efficiency drag-into a prioritized roadmap you help design.
* Lead Across the Organization: Align AV partners, internal teams, and vendors with genuinely competing priorities on scope, sequencing, and tradeoffs, manage the risk without heavy oversight, and land status, risk, and decisions cleanly with audiences from frontline vendor ops to executive leadership.

Basic Qualifications

* 5+ years in program or operations management, including standing up net-new operations or launching new markets
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
* Direct experience managing vendors or BPO partners-sourcing, contracting, performance management, and compliance

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in autonomous vehicles, robotics, or another frontier-technology operating environment
* Background in high-tempo, real-time operations-network operations centers, dispatch, live escalations, or similar
* Track record influencing product roadmaps without a formal product title; strong product instincts and a builder's default
* Demonstrated analytical rigor: you use data to diagnose, measure, and make the case for change
* Experience owning both technical/infrastructure and labor/workforce components of an operation at the same time
* Experience building 0 to 1 structure where none exists and a bias toward acting on incomplete information over waiting for clarity
Willingness to travel globally for partner launches and vendor site visits. Estimate is 25% of the time  

  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $162,000 per year - USD $180,000 per year.  
  
You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

Department Overview
  
  
Electric Transmission & Distribution(T&D) ensures the delivery of safe and reliable electric service to our customers. Electric T&D is responsible for every aspect of PG&E’s electric distribution and transmission operations, including planning, engineering, maintenance and construction, asset management, business planning, restoration, and emergency response.
  
  
Electric T&D Propel drives the strategy, planning, and execution of strategic initiatives that enable the Propel program. The team serves as the primary coordinator across Electric T&D, IT, Asset Management, Engineering, and implementation partners to deliver business capabilities, ensure organizational readiness, and achieve business outcomes.

Propel is the business and technology modernization program that will lead our migration to the latest version of SAP, called S/4HANA. Through this transition we will standardize end-to-end processes, clean our technology core, and enable modernization and breakthrough.
  
  
Position Summary
  
The Expert Program Manager is responsible for leading the planning, coordination, and execution of strategic business and change management initiatives supporting the Propel program. This role serves as a coordinator across Electric T&D, IT, Asset Management, Engineering, and external implementation partners to ensure successful delivery of business capabilities, organizational readiness, and operational outcomes.

This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and your assigned location 2-3 days a week.

Amphenol Sensors— a subsidiary of the Amphenol Corporation, a member of the Fortune 500 (NYSE: APH). Established in 1932, Amphenol has pioneered innovation in electronics for nearly a century. Amphenol is the central hub of cutting-edge electronic solutions across virtually every end market, including Automotive, Broadband Communications, Commercial Aerospace, Industrial, Information Technology and Data Communications, Defense, Mobile Devices, and Mobile Networks.
  
  
Our unique, decentralized organizational structure fosters entrepreneurial leadership and drives excellent performance. We manage locally, enabling us to move at the speed of a small business, with the financial stability and global resources of an industry-leading, international company.
  
  
**Position:** Project Manager
  
WHO WE ARE
  
At NovaSensor, an Amphenol company, we are pioneers in high accuracy sensing solutions. As a global leader in MEMS (Microelectromechanical Systems) technology, we design and manufacture advanced pressure sensors that power critical applications across the medical, automotive, industrial, and consumer markets—whether it's enabling life-saving medical devices, enhancing vehicle safety and efficiency, or ensuring reliability in industrial systems.
  
We are part of Amphenol, a global leader in advanced interconnect systems, serving diverse markets including automotive, aerospace, industrial, and mobile devices. Amphenol Corporation, a member of the Fortune 500 (NYSE: APH), was established in 1932 and has pioneered innovation in electronics for nearly a century across virtually every end market.
  
  
ABOUT THE ROLE
  
In your role as Project Manager for Amphenol NovaSensor you will be responsible for planning and managing new product and customer development projects from conception to product launch and play an important role in the growth of our business.
  
  
WHAT YOU WILL DO
  

* Lead projects from business award through start of production, ensuring on-time, on-budget, and high-quality delivery.

* Drive accountability and execution discipline, ensuring timely completion of action items and fostering a culture of keeping commitments and continuous improvement.

* Bachelor of Science in an Engineering discipline
* 5+ years of experience successfully delivering new product development projects on time, on budget and with high quality

* High energy self-starter with solid organizational skills, and attention to detail and ability to manage a set of projects.

WHERE YOU WILL WORK
  
On-site in Fremont, CA
  
  
WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN OUR TEAM
  

* Competitive salary and benefits package and 401(k) with company match
* Health and wellness programs
* Professional onboarding and training opportunities
* Inclusive and collaborative work environment

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM?
  
PEOPLE – We have the best people, over 1,700 of them across the globe who collaborate to bring our customers world class sensing solutions! Our culture is friendly, collaborative, and focused on serving our customers. We offer competitive benefits, retirement savings, generous paid time off, and more!

performance, continuously improve, and deliver outstanding results. We make it happen!
  
SUSTAINABILITY - We are committed to sustainability, and it is the core of our business. Our products are enabling revolutions in eMobility, energy efficient buildings, smart agriculture, and more. jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Business Unit:**
==================

Cubic Transportation Systems

**Company Details:**
====================

The Services Program Manager leads assigned programs to deliver contractual, financial, customer, operational, and technical outcomes on time, within budget, and to required quality standards. The role is responsible for program financial performance, stakeholder engagement, risk and issue management, and customer satisfaction, with strong emphasis on identifying and converting additional scope (“farming”) within the existing account, a primary measure of success in this role. The Services Program Manager works under limited supervision and direction, regularly exercising discretionary and substantial decision-making authority in a heavily matrixed organization, coordinating cross-functional and offshore teams with the expectation to move quickly, stay organized and remain effective under ambiguity. The role may also provide leadership and management of a service delivery team and is responsible for the performance and outputs of that team. Must be based in, or able to regularly work from, the San Francisco Bay Area.

**Job Details:**
================

**Essential Job Duties and** **Responsibilities:**

* Accountable for leading program execution to meet agreed schedule, cost, quality, and contractual commitments, including avoiding liquidated damages where applicable. Establish program goals, scope, milestones, deliverables, resource plans, risk mitigation strategies, and issue-resolution actions; monitor performance and drive corrective actions to ensure compliant and successful delivery.
* Own day-to-day program management for one or more systems under Operations & Maintenance (O&M), establishing goals, milestones, resource plans, and risk mitigation strategies, and driving corrective actions to ensure service levels, schedule, cost, and quality commitments are met throughout the sustainment lifecycle.
* Ensure assigned programs are executed in compliance with contract requirements, Cubic policies, procedures, and department instructions.

* Serve as the primary customer-facing point of contact, building trusted relationships that support account retention, drive customer satisfaction, and surface opportunities to expand the scope of work.
* Proactively identify, shape, and pursue additional business within the existing account (“farming”), partnering with sales and account leadership to convert customer needs into new change orders or scope expansions; track and report growth pipeline and bookings as a key measure of success.
* Plan and manage resources to ensure program activities are appropriately staffed, fully aligned to schedule needs, completed on time, within budget, and consistent with customer expectations.
* Maintain program financial health by tracking budgets, invoicing, cost-to-complete, and cost/schedule performance for all work, and escalate variance early.
* Lead the full change order lifecycle — scoping, rough-order-of-magnitude and detailed estimates, proposal development, negotiation, execution, and closeout — in coordination with engineering, finance, and contracts.
* Demonstrate command of contract terms and conditions; identify potential entitlements, deviations, or recoverable impacts; and lead change documentation, claims, equitable adjustments, and recovery actions in coordination with leadership, contracts, and legal counsel.
* Review program and service performance metrics and trends to identify risks, opportunities, and process or system improvements, and drive actions that improve program outcomes.
* Manage requirements, risks, issues, schedule, communication, documentation, validation, verification, delivery, and close-out for integrated hardware and software programs, ensuring alignment to contract requirements, CDRLs, verification methods, and acceptance criteria.

* Must be based in, or able to regularly work from, the San Francisco Bay Area.

**Desirable/Preferred**

* Experience with requirements management tools, such as DOORS or similar systems.
* Experience with program management tools, such as JIRA, ServiceNOW, P6 or similar systems.
* Understanding of ISO 9001.
* ITIL certification.

* Experience farming/growing existing accounts or working in a customer success / technical account management capacity.

* Self-motivated, accountable, extremely organized

jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the Role**
------------------

Anthropic's Executive Briefing program brings senior leaders from our most strategic customers together with our spokespeople, product leaders, and researchers. As a Program Manager, Executive Briefings, you will run the program at one of our briefing centers and help build the global operating model that ensures an exceptional and consistent experience across the globe.

You will be the main program lead for your location and own briefings end to end: qualification and intake, agenda design, speaker selection, and day-of execution. You will set the objectives and design for each agenda and develop it jointly with Sales. You will also be the local account teams' go-to partner on how to use a briefing to move their most important opportunities forward.

You will manage the global workstream and set the standard every center follows, so customers get the same quality of briefing wherever they meet us. This is a highly cross-functional role. You will work with regional GTM leadership and the Office of the CCO on account selection and program strategy, with Product Marketing on content, with Solutions on technical deep-dives and demos, with Anthropic's executive bench on sponsorship and participation, and with Workplace, Security, and Revenue Operations on the experience and systems behind every briefing. You will be comfortable running every part of a briefing yourself and maintaining tight alignment with internal stakeholders.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the Executive Briefing program at your location: the local calendar, capacity planning, the request and intake process from Sales, and operating SLAs, applied against global criteria and regional allocation
* Work with regional GTM leadership to decide which strategic accounts receive a briefing each quarter, hold the qualification bar, and proactively surface accounts that should be engaged
* Lead discovery with account teams before each briefing to understand the customer's objectives, business context, and stage of evaluation, and turn that into a tailored agenda
* Own agenda design and co-own agenda development with Sales for every briefing, including the narrative arc, discussion topics, speakers, and demos
* Build and manage the speaker bench for your location: identify, source, and match speakers to briefings, run prep, and manage capacity so no one is over-asked
* Own day-of orchestration and the customer experience standard at your center, in partnership with Workplace on logistics
* Contribute to the playbooks, tooling, and best practices that let the program scale consistently across centers while allowing for regional nuance
* Share intake and triage on a rotation across time zones so every request gets a decision within the defined SLA
* Maintain one source of truth for criteria, lead times, and process so account teams get one answer
* Own measurement and reporting for your center and contribute to global reporting on briefing volume, capacity and allocation, strategic-account coverage, and program-influenced pipeline and expansion
* Onboard and coach briefing team members and contractors across locations

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* Experience running executive briefings, customer events, or a comparable program for senior external audiences
* Program management skills, including intake and prioritization, capacity planning, and managing multiple concurrent programs against SLAs
* Experience designing agendas and facilitating discussions with C-level or other senior customer audiences
* Experience building processes, playbooks, or tooling that help a program operate consistently
* Ability to track, report on, and communicate program metrics such as volume, coverage, and pipeline influence
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to partner credibly with field leadership, executives, and internal subject matter experts
* Work on site at your briefing center when briefings take place

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* 6+ years of experience building or scaling an executive briefing program, or a similar customer-facing program, at an enterprise technology company
* Experience in a high-volume briefing environment
* Experience with CRM and reporting tools such as Salesforce, and with connecting program activity to pipeline and expansion outcomes
* Experience identifying and surfacing speakers for the speaker bench and managing speaker capacity across product, research, and executive teams
* Experience working across time zones or across multiple sites to set one global standard
* Experience onboarding or coaching new team members or contractors
* Familiarity with AI products and how enterprises evaluate and adopt them
* Interest in Anthropic's mission to build AI that is safe and beneficial

jobs.description:
Full-time · Hourly · On-site in Milpitas, CA 95035 · Bilingual Mandarin/English required

**About us**

We're a next-gen cabinet manufacturer rethinking how design and production come together. Combining AI-powered design tools with precision local manufacturing, we deliver custom-quality cabinets at startup speed.

**The role**

You'll be the bridge between our sales and design team and the shop floor. Reporting to our GM Operations and working closely with our Production Lead, you'll keep sold jobs on track from handoff to delivery — checking in materials, running QC on finished work, and keeping inventory and purchasing records accurate. Just as important, you'll be the day-to-day link to our Mandarin-speaking production staff, making sure job details, changes, and quality issues are clearly understood on both sides. You'll also work with customers, contractors, and vendors, mostly in English. You won't be building product, but you'll know the shop well enough to spot when something's off.

**Sales operations**

* Receive each sold job from the sales and design team and check the production package is complete (dimensions, finishes, hardware) before it goes to the floor
* Be the go-to contact for the sales and design team, knowing order status, production timelines, and delivery or install scheduling
* Keep job records and customer notes current in our CRM and project tools
* Flag schedule changes or delays to customers and the sales team early
* Coordinate punch-list and warranty follow-up with production

**Receiving, QC & production support**

* **Receiving:** check in deliveries against POs, inspect sheet goods, hardware, and finishes for damage and spec, and log discrepancies with vendors
* **Quality control:** run QC checks on cabinet boxes, doors, and finishes against job specs before packing and shipping; document issues and pass them to the Production Lead
* **Inventory:** maintain stock levels and locations, run scheduled cycle counts, and keep the system of record (QuickBooks or similar) accurate
* **Purchasing support:** prepare POs for approval, request vendor quotes, track lead times and deliveries, and follow up with suppliers
* **Production communication:** relay job details and customer changes to the production team, track job milestones, and flag material shortages or delays to the GM Operations and Production Lead
* Follow shop safety rules when on the floor and help keep receiving and QC areas organized

**Required**

* Fluent spoken and written **Mandarin and English**
* Strong attention to detail, especially with measurements, specs, and paperwork; willing to learn to read shop drawings and cut lists
* Organized across many open jobs at once, with clear follow-through
* Comfortable with SaaS tools (Google Workspace, ClickUp, QuickBooks, or similar) and spreadsheets
* Comfortable spending part of the day on a shop floor; able to occasionally lift up to 50 lbs when checking in deliveries

**Preferred**

* 2+ years in an office, operations, customer service, or coordination role
* Experience in a manufacturing, warehouse, or production environment
* Mechanically inclined; familiarity with CNC or fabrication
* Receiving, QC/inspection, inventory-control, or purchasing experience; familiarity with ERP/MRP systems
* Customer service or project-coordination experience (HubSpot or similar CRM)
* Comfortability using AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to draft communications, organize information, and speed up everyday work

**Why join us**

* Build the future of local manufacturing at a fast-moving startup
* Work alongside designers, engineers, and makers who love what they do
* See your impact on every job that ships
* Clear growth path toward Operations Lead or Production Manager

**Pay:** $28–$32 per hour, based on experience (hourly, overtime-eligible)

**Benefits:** 401(k); health, dental, vision, and life insurance; paid time off; professional development assistance

**Location:** In person, Milpitas, CA 95035 (commute required)

jobs.title: Senior Quality Lead
jobs.description:
### **The Position**

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Genentech / Roche!

In Pharma Development Quality (PDQ), we strive for confidence in the integrity of our data and processes, agility, and unrivaled transparency with health authorities, patients, and society. Our work provides leadership, know-how, and partnering on quality across Molecules (GCP), Products (Drug and/or Medical Devices), Pharma affiliates, and global regulated processes.

This role supports the Roche/Genentech Organization by developing and delivering Quality Assurance strategies, audits, and conclusions for post approval products, affiliates and processes, based on a risk-based approach. Quality Assurance strategies are based on the Critical to Quality framework, encompassing Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP), Medical Device, and Computer Systems (CS) requirements.

**The Opportunity**
===================

We are seeking an experienced Senior Quality Lead to join the Quality Assurance Programs team. You will bring diverse thinking and technical experience in various Quality disciplines (e.g., GCP, CSV, device).

**Note: This role requires strong level GCP knowledge and will be accountable for the quality assurance aspects and leading/supporting inspections of key molecules. CSV and device are preferred but not the main requirement.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

The **Senior Quality Lead** is a highly experienced Quality Professional who:

* **Designs and delivers Quality Strategies and conclusions** for assigned Molecules by applying a risk-based approach based on the Critical to Quality (CtQ) framework. Establish strong partnerships with business stakeholders and independently define the Quality Assurance approach, assessing specific risk areas and proposing strategy modifications.
* **Define and Lead Audits:** Define the audits required to deliver the Quality Assurance strategy and lead the development of methodology, including the use of data analytics.Independently perform and lead audits, managing preparation, conduct, presentation, timely reporting of outcomes, and evaluation of actions taken.
* **Issue Management:** Independently manage complex quality issues, group individual findings into systematic issues for process improvement, and escalate significant issues to PDQ management.
* **Quality Conclusion and Stakeholder Communication:** Independently draw conclusions on the Quality Positions and ensure appropriate action plans are developed to determine acceptability of evidence of compliance. Lead the presentation of observations and associated compliance risks to business stakeholders and Pharma representatives, including discussions with Legal and Regulatory Affairs.
* **PDQ Goals and Initiatives:** Contribute and participate in PDQ goals and initiatives to the execution and delivery of PDQ work and the development of PDQ processes.
* **Health Authority Inspections:**Lead and support regulatory authority inspections.
* Mentor and support the development of Quality Leads within the team.

* **PDQ Leadership:** Contribute to the long-term strategic direction of PDQ, lead departmental or cross-functional compliance projects, and lead the development/revision of PDQ processes and procedures (SOPs, Work Instructions).
* **Expertise and Mentorship:** Maintain expert knowledge of GCP/GVP regulations, company policies, and SOPs, assess the impact of new regulations, and act as a trainer and mentor for International and Senior Quality Leads.
* **Networking:** Maintain and influence partnerships with senior business stakeholders and PDQ domains. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to ensure quality standards are met globally.

**Who You Are**
===============

**Professional and Technical Requirements:**

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in scientific or quality-related field. Advanced degree preferred.
* Demonstrated applied knowledge of clinical / pharmacovigilance / drug safety and regulatory requirements.
* Project management experience with proven leadership, mentoring and coaching; Demonstrated ability to effectively organize and execute tasks
* High degree of experience, competency, and proven track record leading multiple complex audit types in multiple GCP areas.

**Preferred**

* Device / CSV experience
* Strong digital and data literacy
* Experience hosting, managing and/or supporting regulatory authority inspections; Ability to formulate clear business questions that can be answered with data and utilize data/visualization tools to generate insights.
* Proven ability to influence and negotiate effective solutions, drive change, and assimilate new compliance information/trends.
* Proven record of working in a global, multicultural matrixed organization (multi-lingual skills desirable).

This role is based at our South San Francisco, CA campus. (Onsite presence is preferred, however, a remote option is a possibility.)

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of South San Francisco, CA is $141,000 - $261,800. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at link provided below.

jobs.title: Manager, Finance - Regulatory Affairs & Quality Assurance (RAQA)
jobs.description:
* Sunnyvale, CA, United States
* Not Remote
* Finance & Accounting
* JOB219619

  

### **Company Description**

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.

### **Job Description**

**Primary Function of Position**

The Finance Manager will be the lead finance partner to Intuitive's Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance
  
(RAQA) leadership teams, including Regulatory Affairs, Product Quality, Post Market Survey (PMS), Quality
  
Systems and Compliance (QS&C), and Compliance Audits. This role is responsible for financial planning, strategic and economic decision support, expense and headcount management, performance reporting, and data-driven business insights for the RAQA organization.

The Manager will lead 2 Analysts in supporting these functions and will work closely with partners across Finance, Global Operations, Services, and other cross- functional organizations. The Manager will lead, grow, empower, and inspire team members and collaborate across the broader Finance
  
organization to enable Intuitive's strategic, operational, quality, and financial goals.

**Role and Responsibilities**

* Lead month-end close, quarterly forecasting, annual budgeting, and related financial planning processes across all RAQA functions, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and strong business ownership.
* Deliver a thorough and thoughtful 3-year Long Range Model (LRM3) that links functional priorities, resource requirements, strategic investments, and productivity opportunities to enterprise objectives.
* Serve as a trusted strategic finance partner to RAQA leadership by translating business priorities into financial implications, resource allocation choices, risks, and actionable recommendations.
* Lead workforce and expense planning, including headcount reconciliation, hiring plans, attrition, open requisitions, and investment phasing, with clear visibility for functional leadership.
* Create financial and scenario models to support key investment decisions. Establish expected outcomes and rigorously assess return on investment and post-implementation performance.
* Provide in-depth analysis of actual spending, commitments, and remaining budget to identify trends, emerging risks, investment capacity, and opportunities to optimize cost and resource deployment
* Partner with Regulatory Affairs leaders to support Global Expansion, including financial planning, scenario analysis, resource requirements, and investment trade-offs associated with regulatory readiness and market expansion priorities.

jobs.title: KYC Program Manager
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Program Manager to support the design, implementation, and ongoing management of Know Your Customer (KYC) compliance programs within Meta's financial services and payments ecosystem. In this role, you will help ensure that Meta's customer due diligence, identity verification, and onboarding controls meet applicable regulatory requirements and internal policy standards. You will partner with cross-functional teams including Legal, Engineering, Product, and Operations to identify compliance gaps, drive program improvements, and scale KYC processes as Meta's payments and financial products grow. This is an opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a compliance function that directly supports the integrity and trustworthiness of Meta's financial services offerings.  
  
  

### **KYC Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Manage and support the execution of KYC program initiatives, including customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence, and identity verification workflows across Meta's payments and financial services products
* Monitor KYC program health by tracking key performance indicators, identifying control gaps, and escalating risks or issues to appropriate stakeholders
* Partner with Engineering, Product, Legal, and Operations teams to design and implement scalable KYC controls and onboarding processes that meet regulatory requirements
* Translate regulatory requirements and internal policy standards into clear operational procedures and technical specifications for cross-functional partners
* Drive process improvements and operational enhancements that increase the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of KYC workflows
* Develop and maintain program documentation including policies, procedures, process maps, and control inventories relevant to KYC and customer due diligence obligations
* Support regulatory examinations, internal audits, and compliance reviews by preparing documentation, responding to inquiries, and tracking remediation efforts
* Collaborate with data and analytics partners to build reporting and monitoring capabilities that provide visibility into KYC program performance and risk exposure
* Communicate program status, risks, and outcomes clearly to stakeholders across compliance, legal, and business functions, including periodic updates to leadership

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of experience in compliance program management, regulatory operations, or a related function within financial services, fintech, or a technology company with payment or financial products
* Experience managing cross-functional projects involving both technical and non-technical stakeholders, with the ability to drive work to completion with limited oversight
* Experience translating regulatory or policy requirements into operational procedures, controls, or technical specifications
* Experience with KYC, customer onboarding, due diligence, identity verification, risk, or compliance frameworks and their operational implementation
* Experience designing and operating model monitoring, testing, or attestation frameworks and producing audit- or regulator-ready evidence
* Proficiency in data analysis and techniques (SQL) to perform root cause analysis and inform process-based redesign

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience developing and implementing automation (e.g., performing prompt engineering, benchmarking, launch planning) in a business context
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Familiarity with BSA/AML regulatory requirements, FinCEN guidance, or international KYC standards applicable to payments or financial services products
* Experience using data analysis or reporting tools to monitor compliance program metrics and surface actionable insights for program improvement
* Experience working with automated identity verification platforms, onboarding tooling, or KYC technology solutions in a fintech or payments environment

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  
  
Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process.

jobs.description:
Program Manager, Social Science Matrix (4800C) #89496 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The Social Science Matrix is UC Berkeley's flagship institute for social science research. We provide an organizational framework to support the cross-disciplinary research pursued by more than 500 social scientists across the Berkeley campus research landscape and beyond. Matrix provides an intellectual hub for faculty, graduate students, and colleagues to collaborate as we bring the unique tools of the social sciences to bear on the urgent matters of this moment.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Program Manager works closely with the Director to help develop and implement an intellectual vision and programming calendar for Matrix; to identify and pursue collaborative initiatives; and to identify and pursue fundraising strategies. This position involves a blend of program administration, event management, outreach, and development activities to support the diverse needs of the academic community served by the Matrix, which consists of faculty and graduate students across the social sciences. Ideally, the Program Manager will have a background or an advanced degree in the social sciences, substantial experience in writing/editing, and be a thought partner to help the Director identify promising topics and speakers.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
The First Review Date for this job is October 29, 2026. For full consideration, please apply by the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Program Administration & Management
  
  
Collaborates with the faculty Director to conceptualize, develop, and monitor programs and activities across Matrix's research portfolio, ensuring alignment with the institution's strategic goals.
  
Coordinates the call for applications and reviewers for Matrix programs, managing timelines, communications, and selection processes.
  
Prepares detailed agendas and comprehensive reports for advisory board meetings, ensuring all necessary documentation and materials are available.
  
Serves as primary administrative contact and point of support for the Director; efficiently funnels inquiries and time-sensitive items to appropriate personnel.
  
Meets regularly with faculty fellows and occasionally attends research teams' meetings to stay informed about ongoing projects and provide administrative support.
  
Meets frequently with Matrix fellows and grant recipients to support their research and organize their events, offering guidance on logistics and planning.
  
Participates in planning, organizing, and staffing program events of varied scope and complexity, some of which will occasionally take place during early evening or weekend hours.
  
Develops and implements event budgets, monitors expenditures, and determines event staffing needs to ensure fiscal responsibility and adequate support.
  
Coordinates and assists with event catering, AV services, and guest travel, accommodation, and reimbursement in collaboration with the events assistant.
  
Researches and resolves vendor issues, processes invoices, and ensures timely payment for services rendered.
  
  
Outreach and Engagement
  
  
Collaborates with the Communications Director on the style, content, and functionality of Matrix media, including website, newsletter, and marketing, with the goal of promoting the mission and activities of Matrix.
  
Produces content for reports, website, and media, highlighting the achievements and activities of Matrix programs.
  
Works with the Faculty Director to research topics and guests, and develop interview questions for Matrix podcasts, ensuring content aligns with the institution's academic standards.
  
Conducts interviews for Matrix podcasts and audits transcripts for accuracy, ensuring high-quality and professional presentations.
  
Oversees outreach to constituencies on campus to cultivate their participation in Matrix, fostering a sense of community and engagement.
  
Promotes Matrix services for joint programming, center or research support, encouraging collaboration and interdisciplinary initiatives.
  
  
Space Management
  
  
Maintains the physical space and enclosed event spaces, ensuring they are clean, organized, and ready for use.
  
Serves as the point of contact for event space use for Matrix partners and acts as a liaison to groups utilizing the space.
  
Communicates policies regarding the use of Matrix space to visitors and occasional users.
  
Provides technical support for installed AV systems and sets up spaces for both Matrix and non-Matrix events.
  
Manages scheduling and booking of event spaces, ensuring efficient use of facilities and preventing scheduling conflicts.
  
Develops and implements procedures for supply inventory and to keep equipment in good working condition.
