jobs.title: Customer Success & Deployment Leader
jobs.description:
### **About Noble Machines**

Noble Machines builds multipurpose robots to support human workers in the world's toughest jobs—turning dangerous work from a necessity into a choice. Our work demands reliability, robustness, and readiness for the unexpected—on time, every time. We're assembling a mission-driven team focused on delivering real impact in heavy industry, from construction and mining to energy. If you're driven to build rugged, reliable products that solve real-world problems, we'd love to talk.

### **Position Overview**

We're looking for an exceptional Customer Success & Deployment Leader to build and lead the organization that takes Noble Machines' general-purpose robots from signed contract to dependable, everyday operation at customer sites. This is a high-impact, high-ownership role: you'll own customer outcomes from the first pilot through fleet scale-up, renewal, and expansion, and you'll be the bridge between our customers and Noble Machines' engineering, autonomy, product, and service teams. You'll make sure our robots show up ready for the realities of construction, mining, and energy sites - and that they keep delivering value long after they arrive.

### **Responsibilities**

* Build the organization. Build and lead a team of deployment program managers, field and application engineers, and customer success managers, scaling the team and its leadership as Noble Machines grows.
* Own deployments end-to-end. Take full ownership from site assessment and task scoping through validation in Sunnyvale, on-site integration, commissioning, and hand-off to steady-state operations.
* Set deployment readiness standards. Define the safety, reliability, uptime, and performance criteria a robot must meet before it goes to a customer site—including readiness for dust, vibration, temperature extremes, and the unpredictable conditions of heavy-industry work.
* Run a repeatable playbook. Standardize how Noble Machines deploys: pilot-to-production gates, simulation and test validation, integration with customer site operations and safety programs, and change management and training for frontline crews working alongside our robots.
* Deliver and prove value. Track and report robot uptime, task throughput, time-to-productivity, intervention rate, hazardous-exposure hours removed from workers, customer satisfaction, and net revenue retention.
* Close the loop with engineering. Channel field data, failure modes, and customer requirements back to Noble Machines' engineering and product teams to shape the roadmap and improve reliability in the field.
* Manage executive relationships. Serve as the senior point of contact for customers' operations, safety, and site leadership; lead executive business reviews and own escalations.
* Work with partners. Coordinate with contractors, site operators, integrators, and service partners to keep deployments on schedule and on spec.

### **Requirements**

* 12+ years in customer success, professional services, field engineering, or deployment leadership, with at least 5 years in robotics, industrial automation, autonomous systems, or complex hardware-plus-software products.
* Proven experience moving robotic or autonomous hardware out of R&D and into commercial production at external customer sites.
* Experience building and leading distributed, field-based teams.
* Working knowledge of robot autonomy, simulation and sim-to-real validation, and industrial safety standards (e.g., ISO 10218, ISO/TS 15066, ANSI/A3 R15.06).
* Strong commercial sense, including renewals, expansion, services pricing, and deployment P&L.
* Executive presence and credibility with senior customer leaders, from site superintendents to the C-suite.
* Willingness to travel frequently to customer sites, including active construction, mining, and energy job sites.

### **Nice to Have**

* Direct experience deploying robots or autonomous equipment in construction, mining, energy, or other heavy-industry environments.
* Background in engineering or computer science; an MBA is a plus.
* Familiarity with jobsite safety programs and regulatory requirements (e.g., OSHA, MSHA).
* Experience scaling a customer-facing organization at an early-stage hardware company.

### **California Pay Transparency Statement**

Pay Transparency & Compensation: In accordance with California's Pay Transparency Act (SB 1162), the expected base salary range for this position located in Sunnyvale, CA is $230,000 - $300,000 per year.

  

Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on several factors, including the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, technical skills, and specialized expertise. Base salary is just one component of Noble Machines' total rewards package, which may also include equity options, comprehensive healthcare benefits, retirement plan contributions, and performance-based incentives.

### **Equal Opportunity Employer**

Noble Machines is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Pooled Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Location**
------------

SF | Boston

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Department**
--------------

Customer Success

**Compensation**
----------------

* $130K – $150K

**About CodeRabbit**
--------------------

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

  

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation — building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.

**Location: San Francisco, Boston or Austin**
---------------------------------------------

**About the team**
------------------

CodeRabbit is the AI code review platform. Development teams install it on their repositories and it reviews every pull request, so it sits in the daily workflow of a large and fast-growing customer base. The Scaled Success team is responsible for the health of that base, and works alongside a program manager, a content and enablement specialist and a success analytics engineer. The pooled customer success team is new within it, and this is one of its first roles.

**The role**
------------

You work a shared queue of customer accounts. Work arrives when a signal fires: onboarding has stalled, nothing has been configured, the only active user has gone quiet, a renewal is approaching, a cancellation has been started, or a team is using fewer seats than it has bought. You pick the case up, find out what is going on, get the customer configured and back to work, and close it out with a record the next person can read.

What you learn from the customers you work with feeds the playbooks, the automated campaigns and the triggers themselves. You work with the pooled team, the Content and Enablement Specialist, and the account executive who works expansion in the scaled lanes.

Few customer success teams run this way yet. You will learn how to move an account from default settings to a configured, renewing customer in a handful of conversations, and how to tell from the data which accounts need a person at all.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* The queue: pick up triggered accounts, respond within the team's standard, and resolve or route each one
* Configuration: take customers from default settings to a setup that fits their repositories, including Path Instructions, Learnings, pre-merge checks, IDE and CLI, and MCP
* Saves: work cancellation and non-renewal signals, understand the reason, fix what can be fixed, and record what cannot
* Renewals: run the renewal conversation where the signals say one is needed
* The expansion hand-off: when you see seat headroom or a buying signal, qualify it and pass it to the account executive with the context they need
* Playbook feedback: every case the playbook did not cover becomes a note, and patterns across those notes become new content, a new trigger, or new automation
* Case records: notes clean enough that anyone on the queue can pick up where you left off

**Your first quarter**
----------------------

* Complete product onboarding and work your first cases alongside the team
* Work the queue at the team's response standard
* Document the first ten cases where the playbook was missing or wrong, and propose the fix for each
* Contribute to the team's first readout: cases by trigger, resolution, and configuration movement on the accounts you touched

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* 2+ years in customer success, technical support or solutions for a developer-facing product
* You have worked a ticket queue or a shared inbox at volume and kept quality up
* You write clearly in tickets, email and documentation
* You want to know why a customer left, and you record it every time
* You are comfortable on a team where the playbook is still being written

**Nice to have**
----------------

* You can read a YAML configuration file, open a pull request, run a CLI, and talk to an engineer about their workflow without a script
* You have used CodeRabbit or another AI code review tool
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and GitHub or GitLab workflows
* Experience with Pylon, Customer.io or a similar success or support platform
* Familiar with AI tooling and examples of you using it in similar roles

**How we work**
---------------

The team runs on measured results. Campaigns ship with control groups, numbers are labeled by source, and every report traces to rules anyone can audit.

Compensation Range: $130K - $150K

**Overview of Role**

The Account Manager serves as a primary commercial and operational interface between TSMC North America and its advanced-node and 3DIC customers, managing the business relationship across quotation and pricing, demand forecasting and fulfillment, new tape-out management, and technology-roadmap engagement. Based within the North America Account Management organization and reporting to the Account Management Director, this role coordinates closely with TSMC headquarters in Taiwan and with internal operations, planning, pricing, and Field Technical Support (FTS) teams to ensure seamless execution and customer satisfaction. It is a hands-on role at the outset that grows into broader account ownership and new-business enablement, offering a seasoned semiconductor professional the opportunity to shape how TSMC supports its most advanced technology customers.

**Responsibilities**

* Own demand forecasting and fulfillment, aligning internal forecast and program execution across operations and planning to close the loop and complete the business.
* Drive new tape-out management — planning, execution, and operational coordination with headquarters customer service for new product introductions on advanced nodes.
* Promote TSMC's technology roadmap to customers and coordinate internal resources across operations, planning, pricing, and Field Technical Support (FTS) to meet and exceed customer requirements.

jobs.description:

The Ads Platform team builds the advertising systems and integrations that power ad delivery across Netflix's world-class content ecosystem - balancing member experience with strong outcomes for advertisers. As one of the newest entrants in the fast-growing Connected TV advertising space, we're building the identity and audience infrastructure that differentiates Netflix from other ad-supported streaming services.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a senior Product Manager to own the end-to-end lifecycle of the audience identifiers that power targeting, optimization, and measurement across Netflix Ads. You'll define and drive the roadmap for our identity management platform, spanning the identity graph, public APIs, direct advertiser integrations, partner ingestion, and unified identifier storage, and set the strategic direction for how Netflix builds a durable, privacy-forward identity foundation in a rapidly evolving ad tech landscape. Key Responsibilities include:

* Own product strategy and roadmap. Set the long-term vision for a unified identity platform that supports large-scale data ingestion, normalization, and retention, while balancing it against near-term delivery commitments.
* Lead product development. Partner with engineering, science and design to ship advertiser-facing products that make onboarding and managing advertising signals seamless.
* Drive cross-functional alignment. Work across sales, ad operations, marketing, strategy, policy, and legal to bring products to market and drive adoption at scale.
* Champion identity governance. Act as the subject matter expert on advertising identity governance and customer-facing data management.
* Communicate vision. Clearly articulate product strategy to stakeholders at every level, from engineering teams to executive leadership.

**We're Seeking a Candidate Who Has:**

* 7+ years of Product Management experience with a strong track record of launching and scaling ad tech platforms.
* Demonstrated success managing ad tech products through the full lifecycle, including delivery of advertiser-facing UIs.
* Deep understanding of the advertising ecosystem: CTV ads, identity/audience solutions, privacy enhancing technologies and data collaboration channels.
* Industry leading expertise in identity graph matching, including deterministic and probabilistic techniques for linking identifiers across devices and accounts
* Strong technical fluency designing integrations with ad servers, SSPs, and DSPs, with familiarity with APIs and integration frameworks.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functionally with Insights, Design, Engineering, Data Science, and other Product teams.
* Familiarity with legal compliance and the evolving global landscape of advertising regulation.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity, adapting quickly to shifting partner, strategy, and product priorities.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We've built a product customers love and a business that's scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.

At Aircall, you'll join a company in motion. We're ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

  

**How we work at Aircall**: We're customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you'll feel at home here.

This role sits within GTM Enablement, part of the broader Customer Solutions & Applied AI organisation responsible for turning Aircall's AI Voice Agent (AIVA) and AI Messaging Agent (AIMA) into adopted, well-understood products across the business. jobs.description:
Overview:

**Overview:**

HealthEdge is looking for a Data Operations Manager with a focus on data insights who thinks like an engineer, works like a scientist and communicates like a strategist. This hybrid role sits at the intersection of data platform engineering and ITSM-aligned Problem Management – purpose-built to expose the hidden toil, technical debt and repeat failure patterns that drain engineering capacity and impact payer customer availability across our integrated platform of solutions.

You will leverage AI – including Claude and its supporting functions – to ingest disparate operational data sources, model failure trends and surface prioritized insights that drive permanent resolution rather than perpetual remediation.

**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS**

Production stability is a business imperative for health plans that depend on HealthEdge solutions to process claims, manage care and engage members. Repeat incidents, unresolved technical debt and untracked toil create invisible drag on engineering velocity – and visible risk to client uptime. This role exists to make the invisible visible, and to turn data-driven findings into engineering action.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Operational Data Engineering**

* Design, build and maintain pipelines that consolidate data from PagerDuty, Jira, ServiceNow, Datadog, Splunk and other operational sources into a unified analytical layer.
* Develop and curate data models that identify repeat incidents, known error patterns, chronic alert noise and engineering toil consuming disproportionate remediation cycles.
* Maintain data quality, lineage and governance standards across all ingested sources – ensuring findings are defensible when presented to senior leadership.
* Leverage AI and automation – including the Claude API and Claude-powered workflows – to accelerate pattern detection, root cause hypothesis generation and report synthesis across large operational datasets.

**Problem Management Practice**

* Own and drive the Problem Management lifecycle across HealthEdge client-facing products.
* Translate incident patterns into structured Problem Records with defined scope, impact quantification, and recommended permanent fix strategies.
* Partner with Engineering, SRE, Platform and Product teams to embed problem-driven prioritization into sprint planning and tech debt roadmaps.
* Facilitate Problem Review sessions – leading cross-functional teams from data to decision
* Define and track KPIs that demonstrate Problem Management value: reduction in repeat SEV1/SEV2 incidents, MTTR improvement, tech debt resolution velocity and engineering hours reclaimed from toil.

**AI-Driven Insight & Visualization**

* Build interactive, executive-ready dashboards and data visualizations that make hotspots, failure modes and technical debt load immediately comprehensible to both engineering and business stakeholders.
* Apply generative AI tooling to synthesize multi-source operational signals into clear, narrative-driven analysis – reducing time from data to decision.

**Stakeholder Communication & Business Translation**

* Present operational intelligence findings and Problem Management outcomes to Engineering leadership, VP-level+ audiences and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Influence from a strategic perspective where the most urgent pockets of risk to platform availability exist, and drive prioritization accordingly.
* Translate technical findings – infrastructure failure modes, code regression patterns, dependency risks – into business value framing that drives prioritization conversations.
* Author Problem Record summaries, trend analyses and executive briefings that are concise, evidence-based and action-oriented.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

**Technical Skills**

* 5+ years of data engineering experience with production-grade pipeline design, transformation logic and operational data modeling.
* Proficiency with Python or Scala for data processing; strong SQL for analytical querying against large, event-driven datasets.
* Hands-on experience with Jira and at least two of the following: PagerDuty, Datadog, Splunk, ServiceNow – ideally in an operational analytics or SRE context.
* Experience integrating large language model (LLM) APIs – including Anthropic Claude, OpenAI or similar – into data workflows, automated summarization pipelines or insight generation applications.
* Proficiency building interactive dashboards and data visualizations, Amazon Quick Suite a strong plus.

**Operational & ITSM Knowledge**

* Working knowledge of ITIL or equivalent ITSM frameworks – specifically Incident Management, Problem Management and Change Management process disciplines.
* Demonstrated ability to identify repeat failure patterns in incident or monitoring data and drive structured root cause analysis and resolution workflows.
* Familiarity with SRE principles – toil quantification, error budgets, SLO/SLA measurement – and how engineering teams use these to prioritize reliability work.

**Communication & Leadership**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated experience presenting technical analysis to VP or C-level audiences.
* Ability to translate complex, multi-variable findings into business impact narratives that drive prioritization decisions.
* Comfortable driving cross-functional alignment – navigating competing priorities across Engineering, Product, Operations and Leadership stakeholders.
* Self-directed and intellectually curious; you pursue root causes with the same rigor you bring to your data models.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience in a healthcare SaaS environment or regulated platform with high availability requirements.
* Prior role embedded in an SRE, NOC

ServiceChannel is the leading cloud-based service automation platform for facility management. We offer a single platform to source, procure, manage, and pay for repair and maintenance services from commercial contractors. ServiceChannel is well established, but even after over 25 years we still retain the spirit of a startup. We are primed for success, and we are currently on a high growth trajectory. jobs.description:
About GitHub: GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.  
Locations: In this role you can work from Remote, United States  
Overview:

At GitHub, our mission is to accelerate human progress through developer collaboration. We believe people with disabilities should benefit from that progress and directly contribute to the creation of it.

We are seeking a forward-thinking, determined and innovative individual, who is passionate about the intersection of accessibility and technology, to help implement our accessibility strategy, which can be found at accessibility.github.com. This role will report directly to the Head of Accessibility and will be empowered to drive change internally and externally.

The successful candidate will:

* Have a deep understanding of accessibility, assistive technologies, and the ways that people with disabilities interact with technology.
* Have technical expertise that is grounded in professional experience as a software developer or designer.
* Have hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve accessibility at scale.
* Have professional experience managing accessibility initiatives within a large matrixed organization.
* Have a proven track record of delivering results that empower people with disabilities to use technology.

Responsibilities:

The goals of the GitHub accessibility program are to:

* Empower GitHub employees to do the best work of their lives by creating an accessible work environment with internal guides and support for procurement processes.
* Empower developers with disabilities to build on GitHub by including their input throughout the development process, cultivating a culture of accessibility within GitHub, and driving accountability at scale.
* Empower our customers to meet their accessibility goals when building on GitHub by aggressively dogfooding the latest GitHub platform and AI features to run our internal accessibility program, Open-sourcing our internal tools when appropriate, and sharing best practices externally.
* Help improve the accessibility of open source by empowering people with disabilities to contribute, improving the availability and adoption of open-source Assistive Technologies, and improving the accessibility of mainstream open-source projects.

**Program Manager, Operations and Strategy**

----------------

Bonneville Labs advances transformative bio‑economy solutions by removing operational friction for emerging biotechnology companies. Our coworking and traditional lab spaces support a community of Bio‑Doers who innovate faster when freed from operational burdens.

At Switch, we don't just design, build and operate data centers—we are enabling the technology of the future. **The Role: Special Projects Design Project Manager**
-----------------------------------------------------

As a Special Projects Design Project Manager, you will lead the planning, coordination, and execution of design activities for projects assigned to the Special Projects team. You will manage design from early concept through issued-for-construction documents and support project execution through turnover and closeout.

You will coordinate architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal teams to ensure designs meet operational needs, project schedules, budgets, and Switch standards. This role requires strong design management, technical judgment, and the ability to identify risks early while keeping multiple complex projects moving forward.

This position reports to the Special Projects Senior Technical Manager.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Lead multiple design projects from concept development through issued-for-construction documents and project execution.
* Establish project design scope, objectives, deliverables, schedules, and budget requirements.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary design activities across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, architectural, and telecommunications disciplines.
* Manage architects, engineering consultants, and design partners to ensure quality, schedule adherence, and contract performance.
* Lead design review meetings and coordinate stakeholder comments, decisions, and resolutions.
* Review drawings, specifications, calculations, reports, and other design documents for completeness, accuracy, constructability, and alignment with project requirements.
* Ensure designs comply with applicable codes, permitting requirements, industry standards, and Switch requirements.
* Support data center expansions, retrofits, upgrades, migrations, infrastructure renewal, and capacity growth projects.

* Maintain design schedules, track milestones, and communicate risks or delays that may affect delivery.
* Support project budgeting and cost estimating during planning and design.
* Review design changes, engineering revisions, and related impacts to cost, schedule, and operations.
* Support procurement through review of equipment specifications, technical requirements, and vendor submittals.
* Identify design, constructability, schedule, cost, and operational risks and develop practical mitigation plans.
* Maintain accurate project records, design logs, meeting notes, drawing revisions, and document control.
* Partner with Operations to ensure designs support long-term maintainability, efficiency, and reliability.

**What you'll bring**

We also act as a key connection point between customers and the broader GitLab ecosystem, helping streamline collaboration with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Professional Services, and other partners.

The Trainer builds the skills, confidence, and consistent behaviors of the Client Success team across digital marketing, customer service, and consultative sales. * Stay up to date on industry trends, adult learning principles, and new training-delivery technologies; leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve learning design, content development, and operational efficiency while maintaining accountability for accuracy, relevance, learner experience, and business outcomes.
* Own, build, and continually improve the onboarding system: sequence live and asynchronous learning, coordinate SMEs and team leads, and identify ownership and curriculum gaps to ensure clarity, accountability, and progress tracking.

new_jobs.title: Supplier Sourcing Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Strategic Sourcing Analyst – External Manufacturing at Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) will play a pivotal role in expanding and scaling our next-generation cloud services. As a member of the Global Strategic Sourcing Group, you will make strategic decisions that impact supplier cost, technical capabilities, and supply availability, ensuring the delivery of critical hardware to our customers. The Strategic Sourcing Analyst supports the External Manufacturing (EM) Sourcing team by providing tactical coordination of supply, sourcing analysis, cost modeling, supplier management, process improvement, Blanket Purchase Order (BPO) execution, risk-buy purchases, and supplier/product qualification activities. The role is critical to maintaining continuity of supply and ensuring timely execution of sourcing activities with Oracle’s contract manufacturing partners supporting Cloud Infrastructure.

  

* Support sourcing strategies for external manufacturing partners (contract manufacturers), and related suppliers.
* Analyze supplier spend, pricing, cost structures, capacity, lead times, and other commercial and operational data to identify sourcing opportunities and risks.
* Support supplier selection activities, including RFIs, RFQs, RFPs, bid analysis, supplier evaluations, and sourcing recommendations.
* Develop cost models and conduct pricing analyses to establish negotiation targets and identify cost-reduction opportunities.
* Participate in supplier commercial negotiations covering pricing, capacity, lead times, payment terms, liability, and other business requirements.
* Partner with Engineering, Supply Chain, Planning, Operations, Quality, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into sourcing strategies and supplier actions.
* Monitor supplier performance and identify risks related to cost, capacity, continuity of supply, quality, delivery, and manufacturing execution.
* Support business reviews with external manufacturing partners by developing performance metrics, analyses, presentations, and action plans.
* Identify and execute cost optimization, productivity, and value-improvement initiatives while maintaining supply, quality, and business requirements.
* Support new product introductions, product transitions, manufacturing changes, and other sourcing activities throughout the product lifecycle.
* Maintain sourcing data, supplier information, commercial documentation, and reporting required for effective category and supplier management.
* Develop dashboards and analyses that provide visibility into sourcing performance, supplier trends, cost opportunities, and business risks.
* Drive assigned sourcing projects from analysis through recommendation, stakeholder alignment, and implementation.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of sourcing processes, analytical tools, reporting, and supplier-management practices.

Noble Machines builds multipurpose robots to support human workers in the world's toughest jobs—turning dangerous work from a necessity into a choice. We're assembling a mission-driven team focused on delivering real impact in heavy industry, from construction and mining to energy. If you're driven to build rugged, reliable products that solve real-world problems, we'd love to talk.

### **Position Overview**

We're looking for an exceptional Customer Success & Deployment Leader to build and lead the organization that takes Noble Machines' general-purpose robots from signed contract to dependable, everyday operation at customer sites. This is a high-impact, high-ownership role: you'll own customer outcomes from the first pilot through fleet scale-up, renewal, and expansion, and you'll be the bridge between our customers and Noble Machines' engineering, autonomy, product, and service teams. You'll make sure our robots show up ready for the realities of construction, mining, and energy sites - and that they keep delivering value long after they arrive.

### **Responsibilities**

* Build the organization. Build and lead a team of deployment program managers, field and application engineers, and customer success managers, scaling the team and its leadership as Noble Machines grows.
* Own deployments end-to-end. Take full ownership from site assessment and task scoping through validation in Sunnyvale, on-site integration, commissioning, and hand-off to steady-state operations.
* Set deployment readiness standards. Define the safety, reliability, uptime, and performance criteria a robot must meet before it goes to a customer site—including readiness for dust, vibration, temperature extremes, and the unpredictable conditions of heavy-industry work.
* Run a repeatable playbook. Standardize how Noble Machines deploys: pilot-to-production gates, simulation and test validation, integration with customer site operations and safety programs, and change management and training for frontline crews working alongside our robots.
* Deliver and prove value. Track and report robot uptime, task throughput, time-to-productivity, intervention rate, hazardous-exposure hours removed from workers, customer satisfaction, and net revenue retention.
* Close the loop with engineering. Channel field data, failure modes, and customer requirements back to Noble Machines' engineering and product teams to shape the roadmap and improve reliability in the field.
* Manage executive relationships. Serve as the senior point of contact for customers' operations, safety, and site leadership; lead executive business reviews and own escalations.
* Work with partners. Coordinate with contractors, site operators, integrators, and service partners to keep deployments on schedule and on spec.

### **Requirements**

* 12+ years in customer success, professional services, field engineering, or deployment leadership, with at least 5 years in robotics, industrial automation, autonomous systems, or complex hardware-plus-software products.
* Proven experience moving robotic or autonomous hardware out of R&D and into commercial production at external customer sites.
* Experience building and leading distributed, field-based teams.
* Working knowledge of robot autonomy, simulation and sim-to-real validation, and industrial safety standards (e.g., ISO 10218, ISO/TS 15066, ANSI/A3 R15.06).
* Strong commercial sense, including renewals, expansion, services pricing, and deployment P&L.
* Executive presence and credibility with senior customer leaders, from site superintendents to the C-suite.
* Willingness to travel frequently to customer sites, including active construction, mining, and energy job sites.

### **Nice to Have**

* Direct experience deploying robots or autonomous equipment in construction, mining, energy, or other heavy-industry environments.
* Background in engineering or computer science; an MBA is a plus.
* Familiarity with jobsite safety programs and regulatory requirements (e.g., OSHA, MSHA).
* Experience scaling a customer-facing organization at an early-stage hardware company.

### **California Pay Transparency Statement**

Pay Transparency & Compensation: In accordance with California's Pay Transparency Act (SB 1162), the expected base salary range for this position located in Sunnyvale, CA is $230,000 - $300,000 per year.

  

Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on several factors, including the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, technical skills, and specialized expertise. Base salary is just one component of Noble Machines' total rewards package, which may also include equity options, comprehensive healthcare benefits, retirement plan contributions, and performance-based incentives.

### **Equal Opportunity Employer**

Noble Machines is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

new_jobs.title: Case Manager, SUD and Peer Counselor, San Mateo
new_jobs.description:
The Care Coordinator/Case Manager is responsible for developing and providing high quality therapeutic interventions and services in support of an individual’s wellness and recovery. Services include strength-based and needs-based therapeutic case management, problem-solving, therapeutic rehabilitation including skills-building, benefits support, resource development, housing navigation, crisis intervention, and family support.

ACT (Assertive Community Treatment) team provides direct service to acute mental health crisis cases in our new Full Service Partnership (FSP) Program in San Mateo. BACS’ staff does whatever it takes to find permanent housing for homeless people or stabilize mental health cases and the work happens both in the office, or out in the community.

This program will have specialty populations including CARE Court and Substance Use Disorder (SUD) focus. Care Act is a statewide initiative to allow family members and other community members to request San Mateo County to assess and support partners who may have slipped through the cracks of our system and would benefit from linkage to services. The FSP programming itself offers a multidisciplinary approach and ACT model to offer 7-day support to partners experiencing the highest level of need in our county and would benefit from a hospital without walls wraparound approach.

This is a community-based position providing direct, face-to-face services to individuals who are chronically homeless, travel throughout San Mateo County is required, as is transporting clients in your personal vehicle.

**Schedules: Sun -Thurs, Tues -Saturday**

### **Responsibilities:**

* Responsible for development and delivery of a full complement of services, including individual, family, group counseling, individual rehabilitation and case management/brokerage for individuals within the Care Coordinator's caseload as assigned.
* Responsible for utilizing Evidence Based Practice for the designated population/program to assure high quality results and intended impact.
* Responsible for continuously assessing individual’s risk status including risk based on symptoms, substance use, environment, physical conditions, etc and intervening appropriately.
* Responsible for assessing the continued service necessity and creating a service plan that aims at an individual getting better/healthy and accomplishing service goals that are person-centered and belong to the client.
* Responsible for continuous outreach and progressive engagement and reporting disengagement to the team immediately. Responsible for working with outreach team and determining when to disenroll individual based on program protocols.
* Responsible for domain-based assessment, screening referrals, service planning, community planning and benefit coordination which supports wellness and recovery principles. Responsible for care planning and therapeutic case management using a whatever it takes approach.
* Documents and maintains all data collection, reporting, and charting records in accordance with BACS and other relevant county regulatory policies/agencies. Responsible for producing required number of regulatory units of service per month (65% of staff’s time must be providing face-to-face or other eligible community-based support).
* Participates in supervision, staff meetings, consultation, travel, crisis/emergency coverage, weekend coverage, as well as, agency-wide meetings and training, as required by manager.
* Able to work independently and as a member of a therapeutic team.
* Is adaptable and open to change and new information; adapts behavior and work methods in response to new information, changing conditions, or unexpected obstacles. Adjusts rapidly to new situations warranting attention and resolution.
* Is effective at balancing interests of a variety of clients; readily readjusts priorities to respond to pressing and changing client demands. Anticipates and meets the need of clients; achieves quality end-products; is committed to continuous improvement of services.

**Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma required and must have 4 years of paid work experience in mental health/social services. One of those years may be in a customer service function. Degree is preferred.
* Valid California driver’s license, personal vehicle, and proof of personal vehicle insurance coverage are required. DMV printout required.
* Extensive local travel is required, vehicle reimbursement is provided. Care Coordinators transport clients in their personal vehicle.

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* Starting at $27.00 per hour, then $30.00 per hour after satisfactory performance and achievement of all job related goals and requirements for the 90 day introductory period.
* 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and life insurance coverage options for employees, plus a vision reimbursement program. Children’s healthcare coverage is available for as little as $25/month. Average employer-paid benefit value: approximately $913/month per enrolled individual. BACS contributions apply to company-sponsored plans only.
* 31 days off (PTO/Holiday)
* 403b plan.
* Significant internal growth opportunities.

* Most direct service positions

### **BACS Overview**

Bay Area Community Services is a CARF accredited non-profit, community-based agency celebrating over 70 years of serving Alameda, Contra Costa, Sacramento, San Mateo and Solano Counties by providing mental health and social services. *BACS’ mission is to uplift under-served individuals and their families by doing whatever it takes.* We are proud to be one of the leading agencies producing real outcomes to tough social problems. BACS owes its reputation as an innovator to our innovative and entrepreneurial staff. We are seeking individuals who want bring client-centered plans and goals to social services.

Submit a resume with a cover letter highlighting your relevant experience.

**Overview:**

HealthEdge is scaling its BPaaS operations and must demonstrate quantifiable returns on its product investment decisions. This role exists to own that proof.

* Demonstrated improvement in value estimate accuracy across the enhancement request pipeline over time
* Clear, current visibility of risks, issues, and dependencies across all active initiatives

new_jobs.title: Data Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
Overview:

**Overview:**

HealthEdge is looking for a Data Operations Manager with a focus on data insights who thinks like an engineer, works like a scientist and communicates like a strategist. This hybrid role sits at the intersection of data platform engineering and ITSM-aligned Problem Management – purpose-built to expose the hidden toil, technical debt and repeat failure patterns that drain engineering capacity and impact payer customer availability across our integrated platform of solutions.

You will leverage AI – including Claude and its supporting functions – to ingest disparate operational data sources, model failure trends and surface prioritized insights that drive permanent resolution rather than perpetual remediation.

**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS**

Production stability is a business imperative for health plans that depend on HealthEdge solutions to process claims, manage care and engage members. Repeat incidents, unresolved technical debt and untracked toil create invisible drag on engineering velocity – and visible risk to client uptime. This role exists to make the invisible visible, and to turn data-driven findings into engineering action.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Operational Data Engineering**

* Design, build and maintain pipelines that consolidate data from PagerDuty, Jira, ServiceNow, Datadog, Splunk and other operational sources into a unified analytical layer.
* Develop and curate data models that identify repeat incidents, known error patterns, chronic alert noise and engineering toil consuming disproportionate remediation cycles.
* Maintain data quality, lineage and governance standards across all ingested sources – ensuring findings are defensible when presented to senior leadership.
* Leverage AI and automation – including the Claude API and Claude-powered workflows – to accelerate pattern detection, root cause hypothesis generation and report synthesis across large operational datasets.

**Problem Management Practice**

* Own and drive the Problem Management lifecycle across HealthEdge client-facing products.
* Translate incident patterns into structured Problem Records with defined scope, impact quantification, and recommended permanent fix strategies.
* Partner with Engineering, SRE, Platform and Product teams to embed problem-driven prioritization into sprint planning and tech debt roadmaps.
* Facilitate Problem Review sessions – leading cross-functional teams from data to decision
* Define and track KPIs that demonstrate Problem Management value: reduction in repeat SEV1/SEV2 incidents, MTTR improvement, tech debt resolution velocity and engineering hours reclaimed from toil.

**AI-Driven Insight & Visualization**

* Build interactive, executive-ready dashboards and data visualizations that make hotspots, failure modes and technical debt load immediately comprehensible to both engineering and business stakeholders.
* Apply generative AI tooling to synthesize multi-source operational signals into clear, narrative-driven analysis – reducing time from data to decision.
* Develop automated reporting workflows that surface trending issues and emerging risk patterns without requiring manual aggregation cycles.
* Support monthly ceremonies by providing KPI and Outcome trending, highlighting influences to trending themes.

**Stakeholder Communication & Business Translation**

* Present operational intelligence findings and Problem Management outcomes to Engineering leadership, VP-level+ audiences and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Influence from a strategic perspective where the most urgent pockets of risk to platform availability exist, and drive prioritization accordingly.
* Translate technical findings – infrastructure failure modes, code regression patterns, dependency risks – into business value framing that drives prioritization conversations.
* Author Problem Record summaries, trend analyses and executive briefings that are concise, evidence-based and action-oriented.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

**Technical Skills**

* 5+ years of data engineering experience with production-grade pipeline design, transformation logic and operational data modeling.
* Proficiency with Python or Scala for data processing; strong SQL for analytical querying against large, event-driven datasets.
* Hands-on experience with Jira and at least two of the following: PagerDuty, Datadog, Splunk, ServiceNow – ideally in an operational analytics or SRE context.
* Experience integrating large language model (LLM) APIs – including Anthropic Claude, OpenAI or similar – into data workflows, automated summarization pipelines or insight generation applications.
* Proficiency building interactive dashboards and data visualizations, Amazon Quick Suite a strong plus.

**Operational & ITSM Knowledge**

* Working knowledge of ITIL or equivalent ITSM frameworks – specifically Incident Management, Problem Management and Change Management process disciplines.
* Demonstrated ability to identify repeat failure patterns in incident or monitoring data and drive structured root cause analysis and resolution workflows.
* Familiarity with SRE principles – toil quantification, error budgets, SLO/SLA measurement – and how engineering teams use these to prioritize reliability work.

**Communication & Leadership**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated experience presenting technical analysis to VP or C-level audiences.
* Ability to translate complex, multi-variable findings into business impact narratives that drive prioritization decisions.
* Comfortable driving cross-functional alignment – navigating competing priorities across Engineering, Product, Operations and Leadership stakeholders.
* Self-directed and intellectually curious; you pursue root causes with the same rigor you bring to your data models.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience in a healthcare SaaS environment or regulated platform with high availability requirements.
* Prior role embedded in an SRE, NOC

new_jobs.title: Special Projects Design Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
### **About Switch**

At Switch, we don't just design, build and operate data centers—we are enabling the technology of the future. Led by Founder & CEO, Rob Roy, we believe in revolutionary innovation, operational excellence and the principle of karma. Switch is where talented people come together to EVOLVE the digital world.

We believe that innovation isn't just about technology—it's about the people, culture, and purpose that make it happen. Every Switch team member contributes to a mission greater than themselves: to create the world's most advanced digital infrastructure that powers the progress of humanity.

**The Role: Special Projects Design Project Manager**
-----------------------------------------------------

As a Special Projects Design Project Manager, you will lead the planning, coordination, and execution of design activities for projects assigned to the Special Projects team. You will manage design from early concept through issued-for-construction documents and support project execution through turnover and closeout.

You will coordinate architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal teams to ensure designs meet operational needs, project schedules, budgets, and Switch standards. This role requires strong design management, technical judgment, and the ability to identify risks early while keeping multiple complex projects moving forward.

This position reports to the Special Projects Senior Technical Manager.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Lead multiple design projects from concept development through issued-for-construction documents and project execution.
* Establish project design scope, objectives, deliverables, schedules, and budget requirements.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary design activities across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, architectural, and telecommunications disciplines.
* Manage architects, engineering consultants, and design partners to ensure quality, schedule adherence, and contract performance.
* Lead design review meetings and coordinate stakeholder comments, decisions, and resolutions.
* Review drawings, specifications, calculations, reports, and other design documents for completeness, accuracy, constructability, and alignment with project requirements.
* Ensure designs comply with applicable codes, permitting requirements, industry standards, and Switch requirements.
* Support data center expansions, retrofits, upgrades, migrations, infrastructure renewal, and capacity growth projects.
* Review consultant proposals, scopes of work, schedules, and fee estimates for alignment with project objectives.
* Lead constructability reviews and identify opportunities to reduce execution risk and improve long-term reliability.
* Evaluate value engineering options while protecting design intent, reliability, maintainability, and project objectives.
* Maintain design schedules, track milestones, and communicate risks or delays that may affect delivery.
* Support project budgeting and cost estimating during planning and design.
* Review design changes, engineering revisions, and related impacts to cost, schedule, and operations.
* Support procurement through review of equipment specifications, technical requirements, and vendor submittals.
* Identify design, constructability, schedule, cost, and operational risks and develop practical mitigation plans.
* Maintain accurate project records, design logs, meeting notes, drawing revisions, and document control.
* Partner with Operations to ensure designs support long-term maintainability, efficiency, and reliability.
* Develop commissioning requirements, turnover criteria, readiness documentation, and deployment strategies before handoff to build and deployment teams.
* Support project closeout, document turnover, as-built reviews, and lessons learned.
* Communicate project status, risks, milestones, decisions, and required actions to leadership and project stakeholders.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* You manage complex design work with clear priorities, ownership, and follow-through.
* You communicate technical information clearly to engineers, contractors, Operations, and leadership.
* You identify design conflicts and project risks early and bring practical solutions.
* You balance quality, constructability, maintainability, schedule, and cost when making recommendations.
* You keep multiple projects organized without losing sight of critical details.
* You build productive relationships across Engineering, Construction, Operations, Procurement, consultants, and vendors.
* You use sound judgment when requirements are incomplete or priorities change.
* You maintain high standards for documentation, design quality, and operational readiness.
* You take ownership of project outcomes and follow issues through resolution.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------
